profile.summary: GB Bond Holdings Berhad, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells industrial adhesives, emulsion polymers, and sealants. The company offers water-based industrial adhesives in customized formulations; emulsion polymers in standard and customized specifications for applications in industrial adhesives, gloves coatings, paints and coatings, and textiles and fabrics; and silicone-based, acrylic based, and MS polymer-based sealants in standard specifications for application on various surfaces, such as wood, concrete, metal, and marble. It also engages in the trading of chemical products. The company serves customers in Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Indonesia, and internationally. GB Bond Holdings Berhad was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Nibong Tebal, Malaysia.
profile.zh: GB Bond Holdings Berhad 通过子公司制造和销售工业粘合剂、乳液聚合物和密封胶。公司成立于2000年，总部位于马来西亚 Nibong Tebal，服务马来西亚、越南、泰国、印度尼西亚及国际市场。
lines: 工业粘合剂：提供定制配方的水基工业粘合剂，销售给工业客户。
乳液聚合物：提供标准和定制规格的乳液聚合物，应用于工业粘合剂、手套涂层、油漆涂料及纺织品。
密封胶：提供标准规格的硅酮基、丙烯酸基和 MS 聚合物基密封胶，用于木材、混凝土、金属和大理石等表面。
化工产品贸易：从事化工产品的贸易业务。
lines_en: Industrial Adhesives: Offers water-based industrial adhesives in customized formulations for industrial customers.
Emulsion Polymers: Provides standard and customized emulsion polymers for industrial adhesives, glove coatings, paints and coatings, and textiles and fabrics.
Sealants: Offers silicone-based, acrylic-based, and MS polymer-based sealants in standard specifications for wood, concrete, metal, and marble surfaces.
Chemical Products Trading: Engages in the trading of chemical products.
